stem: Each week a sports team plays one home match and one away match. In their home matches they score goals at a constant average rate of 2.1 goals per match. In their away matches they score goals at a constant average rate of 0.8 goals per match. You may assume that goals are scored at random times and independently of one another.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: A week is chosen at random.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the probability that the team scores a total of 4 goals in their two matches.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Find the probability that the team scores a total of 4 goals, with more goals scored in the home match than in the away match.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Use a suitable approximating distribution to find the probability that the team scores fewer than 25 goals in 10 randomly chosen weeks.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Justify the use of the approximating distribution used in part **(b)**.
